text: dsh-sidecar-conversation 为 DSH Web 增加原生侧栏侧问。用户可从回答选文或整个回合创建 Fork，也可创建只携带明确引用的独立会话；之后能继续提问、添加引用并跳回来源。它用 DSH 原生会话接口管理对话，适合想探讨回答细节且保持主会话独立的用户，无需额外 API 密钥。

dsh-sidecar-conversation adds chats to the native DSH Web sidebar. Fork from selected answer text or a whole turn, or start an independent session with explicit references only. Continue asking questions and jump from citations to their source. It uses native DSH sessions and needs no extra API key.
想针对 AI 回答里的一段话追问，又不想把讨论混进主会话。
能不能把某个回答回合分叉出来，在旁边继续探索？
我想只把选中的引用和问题放进新会话，不继承完整历史。
希望在回答旁开个聊天窗口，追问内容和主对话分开保存。
如何从侧栏里的引用快速跳回原回答并高亮选文？
想把另一段回答引用追加到正在写的侧问草稿里。
I want to ask about a passage in an AI answer without adding that discussion to my main chat.
Can I branch from an earlier turn and explore a different direction in a separate session?
I need a follow-up chat that includes only selected references instead of the full conversation history.
Help me jump from a citation back to the exact text in the source conversation.
dsh-sidecar-conversation 的功能「选文侧问」：选中 Assistant 回答中的文字后，可从回答操作区打开侧问，在侧栏创建带来源引用的会话并继续提问。
dsh-sidecar-conversation 的功能「回合 Fork」：从选中文本或整个回答回合创建子会话，继承分支点之前的上下文，并在侧栏继续对话。
dsh-sidecar-conversation 的功能「引用独立会话」：创建不继承完整主会话历史的独立会话，只携带明确添加的回答引用和问题。
dsh-sidecar-conversation 的功能「来源引用导航」：会话中的引用可点击返回原会话，定位来源回合并高亮被引用的文字或整回合。
dsh-sidecar-conversation 的功能「侧问会话树」：依据记录的父子关系展示会话层级，并允许切换可折叠的侧问列表视图。

dsh-sidecar-conversation README · dsh-sidecar-conversation：**Don't understand part of an AI answer? Ask beside it, without cluttering your main Session's context.**

In DeepSeek Harness Web, select unfamiliar text and ask for an explanation in the native right sidebar. Follow-up questions and explanations stay in their own Session, without being written back into your main conversation. You can also ask about a whole turn or fork from an earlier point, with separate messages, drafts, model and permissions.

dsh-sidecar-conversation README · Quick install：With DSH Web already installed, run this command in the same environment and `DSH_HOME` you use to start it:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-sidecar-conversation@0.2.8
```

Restart DSH Web and refresh the page. Keep your existing `DSH_HOME` to preserve conversations and Sidecar history. No DSH source changes or Better Sidebar installation are needed. Version `0.2.8` has been verified in an isolated, unmodified DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` host.
dsh-sidecar-conversation README · Quick install：Select text in a completed answer, or click “侧问这个回合”, then choose Fork or a references-only conversation and ask on the right.

dsh-sidecar-conversation README · 0.2.8: native list and permission lifecycle：The full native session list is now the default. Its rows, workspace management, search, pinning and archiving remain owned by DSH. Use the footer toggle for the optional collapsible Sidecar view; an explicitly saved choice is preserved.

dsh-sidecar-conversation README · 0.2.8: native list and permission lifecycle：Unsent sidecars no longer occupy reusable workspace blanks. Ordinary New Session therefore keeps native permission defaults instead of inheriting an old sidecar's settings and showing Custom. First-turn attachment and legacy blank recovery preserve native logs and permissions.

[Implementation boundaries and verification](./docs/native-list-lifecycle-2026-10-26.md)

dsh-sidecar-conversation README · What you can do：- **Explain part of an answer:** select unfamiliar text and ask about it with a source reference.
- **Continue an existing Sidecar:** append new text or a whole-turn reference to the most recently used Sidecar without losing its draft question.
- **Explore another direction:** fork an earlier turn's context while the main conversation continues its work.
- **Start with references only:** create an independent Session containing explicit references and your question, without inheriting the full conversation.

dsh-sidecar-conversation README · What you can do：The right-hand chat uses DSH's native composer: file uploads, model and reasoning selection, permission controls, messages, tool calls, approvals, stop and error displays. A Sidecar supports continued conversation across multiple turns.
dsh-sidecar-conversation README · Two entry points, the same choices：Select text in a completed Assistant answer, or click “侧问这个回合” at the end of a turn, to open the action menu.
section: Two entry points, the same choices

text:
dsh-sidecar-conversation README · Two entry points, the same choices：| Menu action | Text selection | Whole turn |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 追加到最近侧问 (append) | Add the selected text to the target draft | Add a whole-turn reference to the target draft |
| 从此回合 Fork | Inherit history through the selection's turn and attach its text reference | Inherit history through the turn and attach its turn reference |
| 仅用选文新建／仅用此回合新建 (independent) | Start with only the selected text | Start with only that turn's final Assistant answer |

text: dsh-sidecar-conversation README · Two entry points, the same choices：Append appears only when the current main Session has a prepared Sidecar whose tab remains open. Both menus have two creation choices, optionally preceded by append. The text-selection menu ends with “添加到主会话” (add to main Session), which inserts the same clickable reference into the native main composer without creating or switching a Sidecar. Drafts and sent citations retain exact-selection highlighting. If the right dock is collapsed but the tab remains open, append reveals the target Sidecar. Closed tabs and unprepared drafts are not eligible targets.
section: Two entry points, the same choices

text: dsh-sidecar-conversation README · Two entry points, the same choices：The left menu determines the creation mode. Choosing a new chat prepares its Session and opens the native composer directly, without another mode choice or an automatic model call. The new draft contains only the current source and does not copy another Sidecar's selections.
section: Two entry points, the same choices

text:
dsh-sidecar-conversation README · From references to continued conversation：1. Select text or a turn on the left, then choose append, independent creation or Fork.
2. Edit your question on the right and choose files, model and permissions as needed. Add references from the left one at a time, or remove individual draft references.
3. Click a draft reference to return to its source: a text reference highlights only the selected text; a whole-turn reference highlights the turn. Sent references remain clickable.
4. Continue in the current Sidecar after sending. Switching main Sessions, reopening tabs and refreshing restore each child Session's state without mixing selections or returning to an older Sidecar.

dsh-sidecar-conversation README · From references to continued conversation：Selections are limited to 4,000 characters. A whole-turn reference points to the final Assistant answer; independent Sessions receive that explicit reference, while only Fork inherits earlier history. Missing or unreadable sources produce an error while preserving the reference.

dsh-sidecar-conversation README · Fork and independent Sessions：| | Linked Sidecar (Fork) | Independent Session |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Context | Main conversation history through the selected turn | Only explicitly added references and questions |
| Native relationship | Child of the main Session | No native parent, alongside the main Session |
| Fork progress | Links the fork turn, lag count and latest parent turn | Indicates references only, without a Fork gap |
| History entry | Listed in the source Session's Sidecar history | Also recoverable from the source Session's Sidecar history |

dsh-sidecar-conversation README · Fork and independent Sessions：A Fork contains context from the point of branching and does not follow the main conversation live. The progress row updates when the main Session adds turns; appending references neither reduces the lag count nor merges later history automatically.

dsh-sidecar-conversation README · Fork and independent Sessions：Both modes use the source workspace. Menu-created chats use DSH’s native read-only preset and permission menu. The `inherit` permission option copies the main Session’s current preset once; later permission changes are independent. Genuine custom permissions retain their native sandbox and approval values. Tools with write access modify the same workspace files. Read-only does not imply network isolation. Sidecar messages belong to their own Session and are not automatically sent back to the main conversation.

dsh-sidecar-conversation README · Titles, history and recovery：Initial titles summarize the first question. The left list, right tab and history then read the native Session title, including manual renames. Linked Sidecars use the native row's leading `↳` decoration and hover card; native activity indicators take precedence. History follows native manual order, recency, pins and workspace grouping through a plugin-owned read-only adapter over the existing Workspace view store. Folding groups does not hide their history entries.

dsh-sidecar-conversation README · Titles, history and recovery：Sidecar history supports creation, reopening, archival and restoration. Closing a tab closes its view without stopping background generation; plugin archival does not delete the native Session. History creation starts from the main Session's latest completed answer and offers Fork or independent mode; without a completed answer, it asks you to finish a turn first.

dsh-sidecar-conversation README · Titles, history and recovery：Messages, replies, attachments and tool events use native DSH Session capabilities. `sidecar-conversation.json` stores the Sidecar index; drafts and tab layouts are browser state. After clearing browser data, history can reopen sent conversations, but session logs cannot recover unsent drafts. [Native session-log ownership and upgrade boundaries](./docs/native-session-log.md)

dsh-sidecar-conversation README · Check DSH compatibility before installation：Version `0.2.8` uses public DSH APIs and its unified list was verified against unmodified DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`. No DSH source patch or Better Sidebar installation is required:

dsh-sidecar-conversation README · Check DSH compatibility before installation：- `sidebar.session.row.leading` / `sidebar.session.row.hover`: existing public row decorations; titles remain native.
- `sidebar.workspaces` / `shell.overlay`: the public slot ledger supplies the existing root view-store handle; the plugin renders the unified list and reuses native preferences and ordering actions, without a second order store.

dsh-sidecar-conversation README · Check DSH compatibility before installation：All Sidecar extensions live in the plugin; no DSH source patch or custom `uiWorkspace.sessionOrder` / `sidebar.workspaces.session.title` service is needed. A public sidebar slot supplies a collapsible Session tree from the plugin registry, including on rc.3 where ordinary Fork logs omit parent links. Independent chats remain roots. Native titles, order data, composer and session logs remain authoritative. The full native list is the default: DSH owns row rendering, search, ordering, pinning, archiving and workspace management. A persistent footer toggle opens the plugin's collapsible hierarchy view. That optional view uses native state and actions but still renders its own rows; it needs compatibility testing when DSH changes. No private row imports or DSH patches are used.

dsh-sidecar-conversation README · Check DSH compatibility before installation：Unsent independent sidecars keep their native Session and logs outside workspace membership until their first native turn starts. This prevents native New Session from reusing a reserved blank with sidecar permissions. Recovery also detaches legacy blank sidecars without rewriting permissions or deleting logs; they remain accessible through sidecar history. Ordinary new sessions retain DSH's native defaults.

[Full compatibility details](./docs/compatibility.md)

Use a separate DSH_HOME, port and plugin directory for development builds to protect your daily instance. Uninstall with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-sidecar-conversation`.
